_comment: EU + neighboring-Europe hotels AI-receptionist pitch (19-country footprint per countries.txt/queries.txt, widened 2026-07-15 to fix a volume collapse). Fixed copy, no signal variation. Copy must not claim specific languages since most sends now go outside ES/IT/FR. Money/commission wording is intentional (the hook). No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
subject_template: Adding bookings to {name}, at zero cost
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

I'd like to help {name} capture the bookings it is currently losing to missed calls, without charging you anything until those bookings actually happen.

We have built a 24/7 AI receptionist that does not replace anyone at your front desk. She only picks up the calls that go unanswered, after hours, during the breakfast rush, or when reception is already on another line. She speaks English plus the major languages of the European hospitality market, answers room and rate questions, and books reservations straight into your system. Setup is free. There is no monthly fee. We only earn a small commission when she books a paying guest for you.

If you would like to hear her first, this short video shows an example of how she could sound in English: https://video.osgdev.com. It plays straight in your browser, nothing to download.

I am David Geha at OSG (osgdev.com), AI consultants working with hospitality businesses across Europe.

Are you free for a 20-minute demo call this week? I will walk you through exactly how it works.

Best,
David Geha
OSG, osgdev.com
